$comment: Ranked season schedule, written by hand: see docs/editorial-data.md. Dates are SERVER time (UTC-8), written the way the patch notes write them, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. When a patch note announces a season end or start, add it here with that patch note as source; leave end null until it is announced, never estimate it. For seasons after the last one listed here, the page also reads the announcements of the synced patch notes.
